step.action: Parse {story_files} into a list — split on spaces or commas, trim whitespace from each path, filter out empty entries
Store {story_count} = number of story files in the list

step.goal: Load and merge all story files
step.action: For EACH path in the {story_files} list: read the COMPLETE file content
From each story, extract: title, actor, goal, benefit, acceptance criteria (exact list), technical notes

Merge all extracted data into one unified set: - Combined acceptance criteria list (de-duplicate identical ACs; keep all unique ones) - Combined scenarios, edge cases, security scenarios, risks, and data needed - If multiple actors are present, note all of them
Count and store {ac_count} = TOTAL number of unique acceptance criteria across ALL stories
If {story_count} > 1: note in the output how many stories were merged
Pass ALL story file paths (not just the first) so the skill merges every story's acceptance criteria into the unified AST
The skill emits a structured JSON AST saved to AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/reports/story-asts/{suite_name}.json

step.output:
Story Analysis Complete for suite: {suite_name}
Display the following sections from the AST: 1. Acceptance Criteria (numbered list — {ac_count} total) 2. Positive Scenarios 3. Negative Scenarios 4. Edge Cases 5. Security Scenarios 6. Risks and Dependencies 7. Data Needed

step.goal: Self-review — verify artifact completeness and accuracy

artifact-checklist.file: Story AST — must exist and be valid JSON

quality-checklist.check: Story AST JSON file exists and is valid parseable JSON
AST contains an acceptance_criteria array with exactly {ac_count} items — one entry per unique AC found across ALL provided story files. No AC may be omitted.
Each acceptance criterion matches the original text from its source story file — no paraphrasing that loses meaning
At least 2 positive test scenarios are defined
At least 1 negative test scenario is defined per acceptance criterion
Edge cases section is not empty — contains boundary conditions, empty input, max-length, special characters
Security scenarios section covers at minimum: unauthorised access attempt and input injection
Risks and Dependencies section is populated
Data Needed section lists concrete test data values (not vague placeholders)

review.fix-if-needed: SA-2/SA-3 → re-read ALL story files in {story_files}, extract every AC precisely, update the AST SA-4 → add missing positive scenarios covering happy-path and alternate flows SA-5 → add negative scenarios for each AC (invalid input, missing required field, auth failure, etc.) SA-6 → add edge cases: empty inputs, boundary values, maximum length, special characters SA-7 → add security scenarios: SQL injection attempt, XSS payload, auth bypass SA-8/SA-9 → populate with specific values based on the story context After all fixes, save the corrected AST and re-display the updated analysis.

step.output: ✅ Review complete — story AST verified: {ac_count} ACs captured, all scenario sections populated
